Truth.Name: Transformation Over Information
Truth.Principle: Programs deliver guided identity/behavior shifts, not content libraries. The goal is who they become, not what they consume.
Truth.ResonanceConnection: Activates all 6 neuro-axes through progressive transformation stages

Truth.Name: Whole Solution Integration
Truth.Principle: Physical + Digital + Social + AI must work together (not in silos). Information-only products cannot fully activate all 6 neuro-axes. True transformation requires tangible anchors (GABA safety) + structured protocols (Acetylcholine logic) + community (Oxytocin belonging) + personalized guidance (Dopamine desire + Adrenaline action).

Truth.Name: Human + AI Coordination
Truth.Principle: AI accelerates but doesn't replace human transformation. Design for human breakthrough moments + AI support systems (check-ins, tracking, nudges, personalization). Community remains the retention engine (humans connecting with humans).
Truth.ResonanceConnection: AI supports 24/7 but community delivers Oxytocin (identity/belonging)

Truth.Name: Validate Before Build
Truth.Principle: Profit-first validation before months of production. 72-hour founding member test proves demand. Build Week 1 onboarding only until validation succeeds. This protects the creator and ensures market resonance.
Truth.ResonanceConnection: Validates BOTTOM (GABA safety) for creator + audience alignment (BACK Oxytocin)

FM3.Recovery: Soften claims → show effort → add attribution language ("many notice...") → compliance check → If no evidence, frame as beta hypothesis

FM4.Name: Feature-Dump Bundle
FM4.Detection: Bundle items don't map to stages, random "bonuses", physical items unrelated to digital
FM4.NeuroFailure: No integration (physical and digital separate), bonuses don't activate transformation axes, confusion not acceleration
FM4.Recovery: Map each item to a stage/behavior → remove non-serving items → validate synergy (does each make others work better?) → Cross-reference physical/digital

FM5.Name: Building Before Validating
FM5.Detection: Heavy build with no sales signal, months of content created before first sale
FM5.NeuroFailure: Creator BOTTOM (GABA) risk sky-high, no BACK (audience resonance) validation, potential catastrophic loss
FM5.Recovery: STOP → run 72-hour validation → only build Week 1 onboarding until validated → Founding member positioning

FM6.Name: Selling "AI" Instead of Outcomes
FM6.Detection: AI is positioned as the product, tech-focus instead of transformation-focus
FM6.NeuroFailure: RIGHT (Acetylcholine tech curiosity) without LEFT (Dopamine desire for outcome), no BOTTOM (what problem does this solve?)
FM6.Recovery: Outcome-first framing → AI as acceleration tool → mechanism clarity before AI mention → "Makes transformation easier/faster" not "AI is magic"

FM7.Name: Launch Obsession, Delivery Neglect
FM7.Detection: Weak first-week experience, beautiful launch but poor onboarding, students confused Day 1
FM7.NeuroFailure: BOTTOM (GABA) collapses immediately (confusion, no orientation, tech issues), BACK (belonging) never forms (no community welcome)
FM7.Recovery: Build First 7-Day Onboarding Blueprint → daily touchpoints for 7 days → track completion → Fix Week 1 before scaling launch

FM8.Name: Funnel Thinking (Subtraction Engine)
FM8.Detection: Program designed to filter/qualify people out, "this isn't for you if..." language, application process as barrier
FM8.NeuroFailure: BACK (Oxytocin) rejection instead of belonging, BOTTOM (GABA) threat not safety, program filters vs accelerates
FM8.Recovery: Convert to Fast Track → reframe filters as "qualifications you'll gain" → remove artificial barriers → "This is for you because..." language → Acceleration not subtraction

FM9.Name: Neuro-Balance Violation
FM9.Detection: TOP (status) >> BOTTOM (safety) promises, FRONT (urgency) >> BACK (identity) pressure, manipulation flags
FM9.NeuroFailure: Ethical violation, manipulation pattern, trust erosion, potential MMA auto-fail
FM9.Recovery: Reference RESONANCE_CONSTITUTION.xml → Check balance rules → If TOP>BOTTOM: strengthen safety language, add guarantees, reduce hype → If FRONT>BACK: remove fake urgency, add community/identity language → Validate with MMA before launch

FM10.Name: Physical/Digital Disconnect
FM10.Detection: Physical items feel like "random bonuses", no integration with digital modules, timing off (workbook arrives after module that needs it)
FM10.NeuroFailure: Whole solution promise broken, physical doesn't activate GABA (feels like clutter not tool), no synergy
FM10.Recovery: Cross-reference every physical item with digital module → Add "how to use this" videos → Coordinate shipping timing with module release → Unboxing experience as transformation ritual → Work with Transformation Ecosystem Architect to redesign integration

Adaptation.Item: Position as "Foundation" tier with upsell to full 90-day

EdgeCase_ShortPrograms.NeuroConsideration: Shorter programs can build BOTTOM (GABA) + LEFT (Dopamine) + RIGHT (Acetylcholine) but struggle with BACK (Oxytocin long-term identity) and TOP (Serotonin mastery). Position as "Fast Start" not "Complete Transformation".

EdgeCase_VeryHighTicket.NeuroConsideration: High ticket activates TOP (Serotonin: I'm in elite group) + BACK (Oxytocin: exclusive network) + GABA (personal attention = maximum safety). Must deliver on proximity promise.

EdgeCase_SelfPacedEvergreen.Scenario: No cohorts, students join anytime, fully self-paced

Adaptation.Item: AI support becomes more critical (24/7 availability)
Community structure needs "new member welcome" ritual (not just join and lurk)
Async coaching (office hours recordings, Q&A database, email support)
Strong onboarding automation (drip emails, milestone reminders)
Peer matching algorithm (connect students at similar stages)

EdgeCase_SelfPacedEvergreen.NeuroRisk: Self-paced reduces BACK (Oxytocin cohort bond) and FRONT (urgency to keep up with group). Must compensate with stronger AI (Dopamine personalization) and better async community design.

Adaptation.Item: Every claim must cite evidence or use attribution language
Mechanism language must be defensible (no "cure" language)
Timelines must be conservative (show typical not best-case)
MMA compliance gate set to highest sensitivity

EdgeCase_HighComplianceIndustry.NeuroConsideration: Compliance constraints can reduce LEFT (Dopamine excitement via softer claims) but increase BOTTOM (GABA trust via transparency). Frame as "ethical, evidence-based" positioning.

Heuristics.Heuristic: IF avatar is time-constrained (busy professionals) THEN lessons ≤15 min, mobile-friendly, audio versions, micro-implementation (≤30 min/day)
IF avatar is skeptical (burned before) THEN Breakthrough Week 1 non-negotiable, GABA (safety) score must be ≥8, transparent about effort, strong guarantee
IF transformation is complex (>90 days realistic) THEN break into Foundation (30-day) + Advanced (60-day) programs, position as progression path
IF support capacity is low (solo creator) THEN AI + community must compensate for coaching gaps, async Q&A + peer teaching emphasized
IF audience is cold (never heard of you) THEN BOTTOM (GABA) axis must be primary in all messaging, breakthrough proof essential, risk reversal strong
IF program has physical components THEN coordinate with Transformation Ecosystem Architect BEFORE finalizing digital structure (integration is architectural not cosmetic)
IF first cohort (unproven) THEN founding member positioning, pilot pricing (50-70% of final), build Week 1 only until validated, expect iteration
IF completion rate <50% THEN likely: (a) Week 1 too hard, (b) support insufficient, (c) content volume too high, or (d) breakthrough not achieved → Debug with metrics
IF neuro-balance violation detected (TOP>>BOTTOM or FRONT>>BACK) THEN HALT and reframe messaging before launch (manipulation risk)
IF program claims "Fast Track" but designed as filter/qualify THEN rebrand or redesign (Fast Track = acceleration not subtraction)

AntiPattern.Name: Content Hoarder
AntiPattern.Symptom: "More is better" mentality, 50+ modules, 200+ hours of video
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Overwhelms students, completion drops, no clear transformation path, violates "Transformation > Information" truth
AntiPattern.Fix: 80/20 analysis → identify essential path → archive rest as "advanced library" → Enforce LEARN→DO→SHARE→TEACH (forces conciseness)

AntiPattern.Name: Guru Positioning
AntiPattern.Symptom: "I have the secret" language, mystique without mechanism, exclusivity as manipulation
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Violates Radical Simplicity (RESONANCE_CONSTITUTION.xml), erodes BOTTOM (GABA trust), TOP (status) manipulation
AntiPattern.Fix: Mechanism transparency → "Here's exactly how this works" → Simplify language → Remove mystique → Radical Simplicity test (4 questions)

AntiPattern.Name: Copy-Paste Templates
AntiPattern.Symptom: Generic program structure not tailored to specific transformation
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Lacks RIGHT (Acetylcholine clarity), feels impersonal (BACK Oxytocin missing), won't activate specific neuro-axes needed
AntiPattern.Fix: Start with transformation mapping (specific "From X to Y") → Custom stages → Tailored support → Reference MESSAGE_SPINE for positioning

AntiPattern.Name: Launch-and-Ghost
AntiPattern.Symptom: Beautiful launch, then absent creator, community dies, support non-existent
AntiPattern.WhyBad: BOTTOM (GABA) collapses (no safety), BACK (Oxytocin) dies (no belonging), completion craters
AntiPattern.Fix: Support SLA defined pre-launch → Community management plan → Creator visible weekly minimum → Coaching cadence locked in

AntiPattern.Name: Tier Manipulation
AntiPattern.Symptom: Core tier missing key content, forcing upgrade to get "real" transformation
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Violates Truth #1 (Transformation > Information), unethical tiering, TOP (status) manipulation via content gating
AntiPattern.Fix: Core tier = complete transformation path → Premium/VIP = support depth + acceleration → All tiers get outcome, higher tiers get faster/easier path

AntiPattern.Name: AI Overreach
AntiPattern.Symptom: AI positioned as replacement for human transformation, community, or coaching
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Violates Truth #3 (Human + AI coordination), reduces BACK (Oxytocin - humans need humans), over-promises AI capability
AntiPattern.Fix: AI as support tool (check-ins, tracking, nudges) not replacement → Human community remains core → Coach still accessible → AI augments not replaces

AntiPattern.Name: Validation Skipping
AntiPattern.Symptom: Building entire program before any sales, "if I build it they will come" thinking
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Violates Truth #4 (Validate first), catastrophic risk for creator, no BACK (audience resonance) validation
AntiPattern.Fix: STOP building → Run 72-hour validation → Founding member offer → Build Week 1 only → Scale after proof

AntiPattern.Name: Funnel Grafting
AntiPattern.Symptom: Applying old funnel tactics (qualify, filter, scarcity) to Fast Track program
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Violates Fast Track paradigm, creates BACK (rejection) not belonging, reduces accessibility
AntiPattern.Fix: Remove application barriers → "This is for you" language → Acceleration not subtraction → Genuine urgency only → Reference RESONANCE_CONSTITUTION Fast Track principles

MMAEvaluationHooks.Hook: Any timeline claim must cite EVIDENCE_PACK or be framed as hypothesis. Breakthrough Week 1-2 must be achievable (not hype).
One consistent CTA phrase passed downstream. No multiple competing CTAs.
No fake urgency; no guaranteed outcomes unless evidence supports. Tiers by support not content gating.
90-day timeline must be realistic per EVIDENCE_PACK. If unsupported, label as beta or extend timeline.
Primary CTA must be singular and clear. Secondary CTAs allowed but must not compete with primary.
Core tier must include complete transformation path. Premium/VIP differentiated by support depth + physical items + network access, NOT content secrets.
If hybrid program (physical + digital), every physical item must cross-reference digital module and vice versa. Integration map required.
Week 1-2 must include measurable quick win. If missing, program design fails quality gate.
Program must respect 6-axis balance rules from RESONANCE_CONSTITUTION.xml. Cold audiences require BOTTOM-first design. No manipulation patterns (fake urgency, manufactured scarcity, fear-mongering).
Program must be designed as acceleration engine (Fast Track) not subtraction filter (Funnel). Language must emphasize "this is for you" not "qualify yourself".

LoadRules.L1_always_on: This skill's L1 (300 tokens) + awakened skills L1 (~200 tokens each for 2-5 skills) = ~700-1500 tokens
LoadRules.L2_executing_only: Load L2 (3500 tokens) only when this skill is primary executor. Unload when complete.
LoadRules.L3_conditional: Load L3 (6000 tokens) only if edge case detected or MMA score <7 or neuro-balance violation flagged. Unload immediately after use.
LoadRules.L4_meta_only: Load L4 (3500 tokens) only if building/upgrading skills, debugging schemas, or designing SSOT contracts. Unload after meta operation complete.

UnloadRules.Immediate: L3 after output produced, awakened skills not used within 2 turns, any skill after task complete
UnloadRules.BudgetEnforcement: Max total ~12000 tokens. If exceeded: unload L3, reduce awakened skills to 2-3, flag for MOD context budget exceeded.

SelfAnnealingSupport.ExecutionLog: After each run, append structured delta: - task_type + context_size - inputs_present_or_missing - what_failed (if anything) - MMA_scores_by_dimension - user_feedback_tags (shorter/more_proof/more_emotion/compliance/neuro_violation)
SelfAnnealingSupport.PatchCandidates: Weekly or every N runs, generate PATCH_CANDIDATES.md with top repeated failures. Create patch specs for patch_refiner (surgical updates). Generate updated tests to prevent regression. Rule: Only patch when repeated evidence of failure (not one-off vibes).
SelfAnnealingSupport.GoldenRuns: Maintain golden_runs/ directory with successful program architectures + MMA scores. Use as regression tests and templates for similar transformations.

UnitTests.Test: Input: PROJECT_BRIEF + MESSAGE_SPINE → Output: TRANSFORMATION_MAP with 3 stages (Breakthrough/Milestones/Integration) → Pass if all 3 stages present + breakthrough in Week 1-2
Input: Incomplete MESSAGE_SPINE (missing neuro-targeting) → Output: Flag + request Offer Architect or infer from audience temperature → Pass if doesn't proceed without neuro-strategy
Input: Program with <3 support pillars → Output: Flag as delivery risk → Pass if warning issued
Input: Tier structure with content gating → Output: Fail quality gate (tier_discipline violation) → Pass if auto-rejected
Input: 90-day program without EVIDENCE_PACK → Output: Label timelines as hypothesis or request evidence → Pass if doesn't proceed with unsupported claims
Input: Cold audience program without BOTTOM (GABA) priority → Output: Fail neuro-balance gate → Pass if auto-rejected or rebalanced

IntegrationTests.Test: Full workflow: PROJECT_BRIEF + MESSAGE_SPINE + RESONANCE_CONSTITUTION → PROGRAM_ARCHITECTURE + TIERED_OFFER + TRANSFORMATION_MAP + ONBOARDING_7_DAY_PLAN + COORDINATION_NOTES → Validate all outputs present + MMA pass >=7
Sister skill coordination: PCG generates program → TEA receives physical needs → TEA returns bundle spec → PCG validates integration → Pass if physical/digital cross-referenced
Downstream handoff: PCG generates COORDINATION_NOTES → Sales Page Copywriter receives → Validates canonical promise present + neuro-axis priorities defined → Pass if handoff complete

RegressionTests.Test: Golden Run: Sleep Transformation Program (cold audience, 90-day, hybrid) → Validate MMA scores match or exceed previous golden run baseline
Golden Run: Business Coaching Program (warm audience, 90-day, digital-only) → Validate structure + neuro-balance compliance
